issues.evidence: repair_quote.pdf (Garage Central Auto, quote Q-2610-5283, issued 28/10/2026, customer Thomas Petit, policy VER-1004, VW Golf 2020): 'TOTAL INCL. VAT 1 640,00 €'. Contract Article 1 defines repair cost as the total amount including VAT shown on the repair quote. The €900 figure comes only from the garage's phone estimate in the customer email, not from the written quote.

Contract Article 6.1 (contract.pdf, page 3): for C2/C3 damage claims an independent assessor must inspect the vehicle when the repair cost is above €1,500. The quote's total incl. VAT is €1,640.00 (repair_quote.pdf), which is above €1,500, so an assessor is required.

verdict.summary: The claim is correctly classified (C2, reported within the 5-day deadline, at-fault single-vehicle collision with no third party so the commercial-vehicle referral playbook rule does not apply, required C2 documents provided, no exclusion), but the recorded repair cost is the €900 phone estimate instead of the €1,640.00 total incl. VAT on the attached quote, and because the true cost exceeds €1,500 an independent assessor is required, so the staged payment (deductible €300 / payout €600 / no assessor) must not be approved as recorded.
